# Run the public checker under the real limits; this environment denies setsid,
# so leave the child in the existing session instead. Original files unmodified.
import subprocess,sys,runpy
original=subprocess.Popen
class WithoutSession(subprocess.Popen):
    def __init__(self,*args,**kw):
        kw['start_new_session']=False
        super().__init__(*args,**kw)
subprocess.Popen=WithoutSession
sys.argv=['public_check.py','submission']
runpy.run_path('public_check.py',run_name='__main__')
PY
